title: Orion self-install status signal
description: The minimal, always-disclosed payload optionally emitted on install stage change (constitution Article V, channel 1). Never contains knowledge-base content, prospect data, or message content.

client_id.description: Slugified business name — stable identifier for this install, not a secret.

business_name.description: Human-readable business name, as captured in the knowledge base.

harness_status.description: Reused verbatim from dailypractice-mono's HarnessStatus type (specs/001-sales-harness/contracts/harness.ts) — forward-only.

ops_stage.description: Superset mirroring the Daily Practice internal tracking board's list names exactly.

template_version.description: This repository's own CHANGELOG.md version the client started from.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the stage change that triggered this emission.
